description: Verify an agent's IATP codebase/config attestation (Ed25519, fail-closed). Returns JSON validity result. Compliance: EU AI Act Art. 14, KYA-OS, IETF AID. Cost $0.02 per call.

agent_did.description: Optional peer DID that must match the attestation agent_id.

attestation.description: IATP Ed25519 attestation envelope to verify (fail-closed).

name: verify_agent_attestation

agent_id.description: Agent id bound in the attestation.

error.description: Failure reason when valid is false.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Verify Agent Attestation
